description:
## Goal

Auto-mode (dual-track retrieval, no global tool-enable list stuffed into context) becomes the default chat mode. Existing manual enable/pin UX remains as an escape hatch for users who want explicit control.

## Expected Work

- Flip the default behavior for new chats.
- Migration path for existing chats (opt-in or silent upgrade — decide during workshop).
- Documentation update: how auto mode works, when to use manual, how to pin a specific tool if desired.
- Settings UI: toggle between auto and manual.

## Acceptance

- A new chat in a fresh install uses auto-mode end-to-end without the user configuring tools.
- Manual mode still works for users who flip the toggle.
name: agent-inbox-auto-mode-default
title: Flip auto-mode to default and document the manual escape hatch
